name: Ian Mcgillivray
body:
Paul was always the first person I told when I was coming to Cranston. Like clock-work he would walk into my kitchen cus he knew he didn’t have to knock after 28 years of friendship. He was an extended part or our family.  Paul would send me pics when he ran into my parents at Hot club. Isabel and I would go see him spin in Providence whenever we could while in town. 

Last time I saw him was in June. He told me he was opening for Coli Budz (a popular dancehall artist) at Ocean Mist (of coarse). I said put me on the list, and he did without question. He got the place jumping and feeling good. He always did, he was talented at getting people in a good mood and dancing! We enjoyed the show together like it was no big deal. That’s who he was. 

Happiness was his gift. Trust and dependability was his virtue. I’ll miss you Paul. 

Love Ian and Isabel and the entire McGillivray family.
